evidence_boundary: SW2-15 covers Smart Validation DAG only: safe impacted-node selection in develop, complete affected dependency closure in verify, exhaustive finalize authority, and adversarial false-PASS regression. It must not weaken SW2-14 incremental Project Truth semantics, accepted exact-head authority, sequence evidence, cross-platform/consumer acceptance, or any prior V2 guarantee.

requirements.evidence: NOT_PROVEN until the current validation DAG and impact classes are mapped and negative-path tests prove unsafe or unknown impact cannot silently narrow develop execution.
requirements.requirement: Develop mode executes only safely impacted validation nodes and their mandatory prerequisites.

requirements.evidence: NOT_PROVEN until dependency-closure planning is deterministic and regression evidence proves every affected required prerequisite and dependent gate executes exactly as declared.
requirements.requirement: Verify mode executes the complete dependency closure for affected governance semantics without redundant unrelated validation.

requirements.evidence: NOT_PROVEN until exhaustive finalize parity proves every required final node executes with exact-head provenance and clean governed state after smart selection changes.
requirements.requirement: Finalize executes the complete authoritative validation DAG and remains the only final acceptance authority.

requirements.evidence: NOT_PROVEN until adversarial skip/dependency failures, Ubuntu/Windows governance, sequence evidence, engine performance, and real-consumer acceptance all pass on the final candidate.
requirements.requirement: Adversarial false-PASS regression and the complete permanent matrix prove smart validation cannot skip required failures across platforms and the real consumer.
